mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand and construction activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as companies benefit from increased economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is above its 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 1.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates labor market overheating without supply growth, causing inflationary pressures and central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The negative return pattern fails when the joint signal occurs and SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending slowdown in manufacturing, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines during late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A rising CPI (CPIAUCSL) indicates strong consumer demand and economic growth, which typically supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises above its 3-month average.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, it signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising housing starts (HOUST) and a stable or declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy supporting strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The positive return pattern fails when both HOUST rises and FEDFUNDS is stable or declines, and SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: During early-cycle recovery, a sustained increase in employment (PAYEMS) signals the beginning of economic expansion, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases during early-cycle recovery.
